legacy_payload.best_for: 以雾蓝陶橙的现代矢量插画、圆润有机形与大负空间表达沉静、聪明、干净而微艺术的编辑感
legacy_payload.visual_direction: modern vector illustration editorial, soft beige or white ground, muted blue and dusty orange illustration palette, smooth curves and rounded organic layered flat shapes, conceptual subjects of people workflows and abstract systems, balanced editorial proportions with large negative space, thin charcoal strokes, nearly invisible texture, soft pale grounding shadows only, no text

canvas.composition: one strong illustration area + one clear text area, asymmetric

color_palette.primary: soft beige #F7F3EE / white #FFFFFF ground, charcoal gray #2F2F2F text
color_palette.secondary: muted blue #A7C7E7 and pale blue field #EAF4FC
color_palette.accent: dusty orange #E8A87C with pale orange field #FCE8DA
color_palette.rule: blue and orange as illustration colours and accent signals; charcoal is the primary text colour

typography.title: modern bold sans (Inter / 思源黑体), 700-800 weight
typography.body: clean sans (Inter / 思源黑体), 400-500 weight
typography.labels: small section labels (Inter / 黑体), 600-700 weight
typography.text_quality: calm, intelligent, clean — no decorative type

layout_patterns: illustration-text split: one strong illustration area and one clear text area, asymmetric
conceptual illustration plate: people / workflow / system concepts in rounded organic flat shapes
illustrated diagram: rounded nodes, curved paths and layered shapes with direct labels
quiet texture field: nearly invisible low-opacity dot or speckle fields to avoid sterile flatness
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Preserve large negative space; do not over-frame the illustration; modules stay light and open.
negative_prompt: no cartoon mascots, clipart or exaggerated cartoon proportions
no heavy drop shadows or neon colors
no dense dashboard aesthetics or busy full-scene illustrations

visual_elements.allowed: smooth organic shapes, layered flat illustration, subtle local gradients, pale grounding shadows, thin charcoal strokes
visual_elements.avoid: mascots, 3D, gloss, neon, busy scenes, heavy shadows

rendering_constraints: Refined sparse vector illustration, editorial proportions.
Gradients only subtle and local; shadows only pale grounding.

recommendation_features.feature_defaults_basis: family-prior (U3)：机械默认按家族语义先验替换，来源记录在案
